result.summary: Found 1 major layout issue where text elements overlap on a restaurant card.

issues.description: Under the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' listing in the 'Popular right now' section, the delivery time (e.g., '25-35 min') and delivery fee ('€0 delivery') texts overlap each other, making both unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Place the delivery time and delivery fee in a horizontal flex/stack container with proper spacing or separator (e.g., '25–35 min · €0 delivery · Ramen') so they do not overlap.
